overview: South Africa is the southernmost country in Africa. It has three capital cities, Pretoria, Cape Town and Bloemfontein, while Johannesburg is its largest city. From 1948 to the early 1990s it was ruled under apartheid, a system of racial segregation; in 1994 it held its first democratic elections and Nelson Mandela became president. It has 12 official languages.

geography.text: South Africa has coasts on both the Atlantic and Indian oceans, which meet near its southern tip. Much of the interior is a high plateau called the Highveld, edged by the Great Escarpment, including the Drakensberg mountains. The west is dry, while the east is greener. Table Mountain overlooks Cape Town, and Kruger National Park is one of Africa's largest wildlife reserves.
